senses.gloss: (accus. of Λάχεσις) by Lachesis! (the goddess of fate).
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> (in a speech of a gentile robber) <he>א״ל ל׳ לא אשתייר וכ׳</he> Ar. (Var. <he>לאכיסן</he>, <cite ref="L00023"><he>לאכסן</he></cite>; in ed. differ. phraseology, a. our w. omitted) by L.! Nothing has been left to me of all &c. [Ar. explains <cite ref="L00024"><he>לאלתר</he></cite> (?).]
